problem_statement: The networking subsystem provides multicast route lookups by group address only (net_route_mcast_lookup). A caller cannot determine whether a given multicast group has a route associated with a specific network interface. The system needs a way to look up a multicast routing entry by both the IPv6 multicast group address and a specific interface, returning the matching entry or NULL if no entry exists for that combination.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/net/route_mcast -s tests/net/route_mcast/net.route_mcast -s net.route_mcast -O twister-out --no-clean -W
